scoring.zh: 评分 r8.4：按 k 分档计分，不在 0 处截断（N ≥ 0 时 N ÷ P，N < 0 时 N ÷ Σk），整体扣减 max(暂停 0.1, 格式罚 f, ARW 残余 0.1) 只扣一次：最终分 = s − d·|s|；模型失误记 0。
scoring.en: Scoring r8.4: k-tier scoring without the cut at 0 (N / P for N >= 0, N / sum k for N < 0); one overall deduction d = max(pause 0.1, format penalty f, ARW residual 0.1): final = s - d |s|; a model failure scores 0.

phase.zh: 第四阶段补充（只含补充）：Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium / high / xhigh（配置 30–32，Antigravity），每格全部有效实例、不截取前 5 个，stage 为 phase4；本文件不含预登记配置，也不含前三阶段的实例（见第三阶段文件）；补充配置不进任何比较，见 caveats 的 phase4-supplement。
phase.en: Phase 4 supplement (supplement only): Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium / high / xhigh (configurations 30-32, Antigravity), every valid instance per cell, no first-5 cut, stage phase4; this file holds neither the preregistered configurations nor the instances of the first three phases (see the phase-3 file); the supplement configurations never enter a comparison, see the phase4-supplement caveat.

parallelWindows.zh: Strata 加测期间，同一台主机上另有计算进程（nice 19）运行的时段。实例的 parallelWindow 标出开始于某时段（start）或运行中与某时段重叠（overlap）；时段只可能影响速度和用时，不影响分数。
parallelWindows.en: Periods when other compute (nice 19) ran on the Strata host during the extra runs. An instance's parallelWindow marks a start in a period (start) or a run during one (overlap); a period can only affect speed and duration, not scores.

windows.zh: 第一阶段补数据 worker 计算（nice 19，1–2 进程）
第一阶段全量重算（nice 19，并发 ≤2；运行记录为 02:2x–02:5x JST，按整段取）
windows.en: phase-1 full rescoring (nice 19, at most 2 at once; logged as 02:2x-02:5x JST, taken whole)

windows.zh: 第二阶段 CStd 枚举与计分（nice 19，并发 ≤2）
windows.en: phase-2 CStd enumeration and scoring (nice 19, at most 2 at once)

windows.zh: 第二阶段 CStd 枚举与计分（nice 19，并发 ≤2）
windows.en: phase-2 CStd enumeration and scoring (nice 19, at most 2 at once)

windows.zh: SR 计分准备：建 record、枚举、manifest、扫描（nice 19）
windows.en: SR scoring preparation: records, enumeration, manifest, scan (nice 19)

userDecisions.zh: 本文件只提供到每个实例的细节，不提供任何汇总统计，也不提供比较结果；重现所需的设计信息（实例有效性、是否进主统计、前 N 个的选取、阶段、比较设计）照常提供（用户 2026-10-22）。
userDecisions.en: This file gives per-instance detail only: no aggregate statistics and no comparison results; the design information needed to reproduce them (validity, main-statistic membership, first-N selection, stage, comparison design) is included (user 2026-10-22).

userDecisions.zh: 本工程的报告只给分场景结果，不算综合分、不排名（D7）；本文件不含权重或综合分（用户 2026-10-22）。
userDecisions.en: This project's reports give per-scenario results only, with no combined score and no ranking (D7); this file carries no weights or combined scores (user 2026-10-22).

reportConversions.zh: 本工程报告里的两项换算（都不是费用）：Strata 的测量规则等效费用 =（未缓存×0.15 + 缓存×0.016 + 输出×0.47）/ 1e6 美元；Anthropic 周额度百分比 = 等价美元 × 0.086。
reportConversions.en: Two conversions of this project's reports (neither is a cost): the Strata measurement-rule equivalent = (uncached x 0.15 + cached x 0.016 + output x 0.47) / 1e6 USD; Anthropic weekly quota percent = API-equivalent USD x 0.086.

description.zh: 检查改动是否落实已给出的要求。
description.en: Checks whether a change implements the stated requirements.

timeLimit.zh: 阅读量时限 T = B ×（1/P + k/G）/ β，P、G、β 取每个配置自己短探针测出的速度；到 T 硬中断，按已写出的报告计分。实例的 T 见 timeLimitSeconds。
timeLimit.en: Reading-volume limit T = B x (1/P + k/G) / beta with P, G, beta measured per configuration by a short probe; hard stop at T, scored from the report written. Per-instance T in timeLimitSeconds.

description.zh: 对照仓库指令与实现质量标准审查代码。
description.en: Reviews code against repository instructions and implementation quality standards.

timeLimit.zh: 阅读量时限 T = B ×（1/P + k/G）/ β，P、G、β 取每个配置自己短探针测出的速度；到 T 硬中断，按已写出的报告计分。实例的 T 见 timeLimitSeconds。
timeLimit.en: Reading-volume limit T = B x (1/P + k/G) / beta with P, G, beta measured per configuration by a short probe; hard stop at T, scored from the report written. Per-instance T in timeLimitSeconds.

description.zh: 审计暂存的提交候选及必要检查。
description.en: Audits a staged commit candidate and its required checks.

timeLimit.zh: ARW 原版：累计工作 55 分钟提醒、60 分钟中断（每个根线程）。
timeLimit.en: ARW original: reminder at 55 minutes and interrupt at 60 minutes of accumulated work (per root thread).

description.zh: 实施前检查要求的完整性与可实现性；每个实例含两个独立根线程（runtime-migration、artifact-promotion），合并计一个分数。
description.en: Checks requirements for completeness and feasibility before implementation; each instance has two independent root threads (runtime-migration, artifact-promotion) scored together as one.

timeLimit.zh: ARW 原版：累计工作 55 分钟提醒、60 分钟中断（每个根线程）。
timeLimit.en: ARW original: reminder at 55 minutes and interrupt at 60 minutes of accumulated work (per root thread).

notes.zh: Antigravity CLI（agy）：自带 agent 循环、约 10K token 的系统提示和工具集；经 stdin 的 stream-json 送入单条用户消息；bwrap 隔离（只读系统目录、空家目录、只有工作副本可写）；搜索与子 agent 无法关闭，事后检测。
notes.en: Antigravity CLI (agy): its own agent loop, a system prompt of about 10K tokens and toolset; one user message through stdin stream-json; bwrap isolation (read-only system directories, empty home, only the work copy writable); search and sub-agents cannot be switched off and are detected afterwards.

notes.zh: benchmark 专用副本，固定 SHA；ARW Reviewer 运行层；read-only 权限加报告目录写授权，凭据路径 deny-read；搜索关闭；service tier default。
notes.en: Dedicated pinned copy; ARW Reviewer runtime; read-only permissions plus a report-directory write grant, credential paths deny-read; search disabled; service tier default.

notes.zh: benchmark 专用副本，无头 claude -p，不加载任何设置源，dontAsk，Bash 沙箱只读工作目录且无网络，搜索工具禁用。早退接续由 harness 模拟 ARW。
notes.en: Dedicated copy, headless claude -p, no setting sources, dontAsk, Bash sandbox read-only on the work directory without network, search tools disabled. Early-exit continuation emulates ARW.

notes.zh: Windows 原生推理进程，单实例串行；启动提示与压缩提示只给 Strata；参数沿用 v0.1.42 调参。
notes.en: Native Windows inference process, one instance at a time; startup and compaction prompts only for Strata; parameters from the v0.1.42 tuning.

notes.zh: Codex 上走 DeepSeek 官方 OpenAI 格式端点（Responses），请求经本机回环 relay 原样转发，relay 只记录 usage、模型和 tier；Claude Code 上直连官方 Anthropic 格式端点，token 取 Claude Code stream result。只在低谷时段运行。
notes.en: On Codex: DeepSeek official OpenAI-format endpoint (Responses), requests forwarded unchanged by a local loopback relay that records only usage, model and tier. On Claude Code: the official Anthropic-format endpoint directly, tokens from the Claude Code stream result. Run off-peak only.

notes.zh: Codex 内置 openai provider（ChatGPT 套餐登录），经同一 relay 记录 usage；guardian 为原生 codex-auto-review。
notes.en: Codex built-in openai provider (ChatGPT plan login), usage via the same relay; guardian is the native codex-auto-review.

notes.zh: Claude Code 订阅登录，别名在开跑前解析为具体模型 ID。
notes.en: Claude Code subscription login; aliases resolved to concrete model IDs before the run.

codex.zh: ARW Reviewer 的累计工作秒数（各根线程相加），从首个请求进入模型起算，不含部署、加载与准备。
codex.en: ARW Reviewer accumulated work seconds (root threads summed), from the first model request, excluding deployment, loading and preparation.

claude-code.zh: 各根线程 claude -p 会话（含接续段）的墙钟秒数相加，不含准备。
claude-code.en: Wall seconds of the claude -p sessions of each root thread (continuations included), summed; preparation excluded.

antigravity.zh: 各根线程 agy 会话（含接续段）的进程墙钟秒数相加，每段从进程启动起算（含约 7 秒启动），不含准备；与 claude-code 同一口径。
antigravity.en: Process wall seconds of the agy sessions of each root thread (continuations included), summed; each segment counts from its process start (about 7 seconds of start-up included), preparation excluded; the same basis as claude-code.

anthropic.zh: Claude Code 报告的 total_cost_usd：按 Anthropic 价目的 API 等价美元；本 benchmark 用订阅运行，不是实际账单。
anthropic.en: Claude Code's reported total_cost_usd: API-equivalent USD at Anthropic list prices; the benchmark ran on a subscription, so this is not an actual bill.

deepseek.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目逐请求重算（高峰 / 低谷按请求时刻）；美元按官方美元价目表；lowerBound 表示有被提醒中断丢弃的请求未计入。
deepseek.en: Recomputed from the DeepSeek official price list per request (peak / off-peak by request time); USD from the official USD table; lowerBound means requests abandoned by a reminder interrupt are missing.

tokenSource.zh: agy stream-json 每步 usage 之和：input_tokens（未缓存输入）、cache_read_tokens（缓存输入）、output_tokens（输出，含思考；thinking 为其中思考部分）。
tokenSource.en: Sum of the per-step usage of the agy stream-json: input_tokens (uncached input), cache_read_tokens (cached input), output_tokens (output, thinking included; thinking is the part of it that is reasoning).

tokenSource.en: Sum of the per-step usage of the agy stream-json: input_tokens (uncached input), cache_read_tokens (cached input), output_tokens (output, thinking included; thinking is the part of it that is reasoning).

tokenSource.en: Sum of the per-step usage of the agy stream-json: input_tokens (uncached input), cache_read_tokens (cached input), output_tokens (output, thinking included; thinking is the part of it that is reasoning).

selection.zh: 有效实例按开始时刻排序得到 validRank。phase 1：未合并的格取 validRank ≤ 5（firstN）；DeepSeek 合并格（cellPooled，medium 请求并入 high）取全部有效实例。phase 2：Strata 的格取 validRank ≤ 10，其余同 phase 1。phase 4（只含补充）：本文件只有补充配置 30–32（Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium、high、xhigh，Antigravity），各格取全部有效实例（mainStatistic 为 true，不截取前 5 个，用户 2026-11-14），只给实例、不进比较，也没有一致性行。inMain 是本文件阶段的结果；主统计多于前 5 个的格另有一致性行（firstN 为 true 的实例）。
selection.en: Valid instances ordered by start give validRank. Phase 1: cells not pooled take validRank <= 5 (firstN); pooled DeepSeek cells (cellPooled, medium requests pooled into high) take every valid instance. Phase 2: Strata cells take validRank <= 10, others as in phase 1. Phase 4 (supplement only): this file holds only the supplement configurations 30-32 (Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium / high / xhigh on Antigravity), every valid instance per cell (mainStatistic true, no first-5 cut, user 2026-11-14), instances only, never in a comparison and without a consistency row. inMain is the result for the phase of this file; a cell whose main statistic holds more than its first 5 also has a consistency row (the instances with firstN true).

caveats.zh: 本工程的报告只给分场景结果，不算综合分、不排名（D7）。本文件只提供实例数据，不含任何权重或综合分。
caveats.en: This project's own reports give per-scenario results only, with no combined score and no ranking (D7). This file provides instance data only and carries no weights or combined scores.

caveats.zh: 分数可为负（评分 r8.4 不在 0 处截断）：N ≥ 0 时分数 = N ÷ P，N < 0 时分数 = N ÷ Σk，正负两侧单位不同；不设下限，可低于 −1。模型失误（没有报告）记 0。
caveats.en: Scores can be negative (scoring r8.4 does not cut at 0): N / P for N >= 0, N / sum k for N < 0, so the two sides have different units; no lower bound (can fall below -1). A model failure (no report) scores 0.

caveats.zh: null 表示未知或不适用，不是 0。
caveats.en: null means unknown or not applicable, never zero.

caveats.zh: 每格预登记 5 个实例；5 对 5 时能分辨的分差约 0.3。
caveats.en: Five preregistered instances per cell; with 5 against 5 the resolvable difference is about 0.3.

caveats.zh: 第四阶段只是补充（用户 2026-11-14）：Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium / high / xhigh（配置 30–32，Antigravity）在 4 个场景各格取全部有效实例（不截取前 5 个），只给逐实例结果，不进预登记比较；本文件只含这三个配置，预登记配置与前三阶段在第三阶段文件里。运行于 2026-11-14（JST），晚于 v1 约三周，服务端模型或路由可能已有变化，也没有同期对照。
caveats.en: Phase 4 is a supplement only (user 2026-11-14): Gemini 4 Hydrogen medium / high / xhigh (configurations 30-32, Antigravity), every valid instance of each cell in the 4 scenarios (no first-5 cut), per-instance results only, never in a preregistered comparison; this file holds only these three configurations, the preregistered ones and the first three phases are in the phase-3 file. Run on 2026-11-14 (JST), about three weeks after v1, so the served model or routing may have changed, and there is no same-period control.

caveats.zh: Hydrogen 在 Antigravity（agy）上运行，不是 v1 的 Codex 或 Claude Code：agy 自带系统提示（空提示实测约 10K token 输入）、工具集和上下文管理，Role 指令放在用户消息里；搜索和子 agent 无法关闭，只能事后检测（作废重跑，最终实例中没有）；agy 的 --sandbox 拦不住读取，改用 bwrap 隔离；模型 id 只有请求回显（弱核对）；盲裁者 claude 版本与 v1 不同，Hydrogen 作为新的来源 family 另登记了 14 个锚点。所以 Hydrogen 与 v1 配置的分差不能全归于模型。agy 版本在运行中从 1.5.8 升到 1.5.9（2026-11-14 14:55 JST），每个实例的版本见 harnessVersion。
caveats.en: Hydrogen ran on Antigravity (agy), not on v1's Codex or Claude Code: agy brings its own system prompt (about 10K input tokens with an empty prompt, measured), toolset and context management, and the Role instruction sits in the user message; search and sub-agent tools cannot be switched off and were only detected afterwards (such runs voided and rerun, none among the final instances); agy --sandbox does not stop reads, so isolation uses bwrap; the model id is only the requested one echoed back (a weak check); the blind-adjudicator claude version differs from v1 and Hydrogen, a new source family, got 14 anchors of its own. So differences between Hydrogen and the v1 configurations cannot all be put down to the model. agy went from 1.5.8 to 1.5.9 during the runs (2026-11-14 14:55 JST); the version of each instance is in harnessVersion.

caveats.zh: Antigravity 的引擎速度不给（null）：stream 只有每次响应的秒数，没有规则把它换成引擎输入或输出速度；任务速度照通用公式（未缓存输入、输出 ÷ 工作秒数）。
caveats.en: Antigravity engine speeds are not given (null): the stream has per-response seconds but no rule turns them into an engine input or output speed; task speeds follow the common formula (uncached input and output over work seconds).
